source: FIX 33 Step 0 verify-then-branch probe (presentation_job/ocr_verify.py). Branch A on the operator box 2026-08-31: the pipeline interpreter's OCR stack measured present and FUNCTIONAL (real one-line fixture OCR passed). No install mutation. These are the observed compatible versions pinned for the portable bundle (FIX 38 packaging) — pins are checked against the live probe at launch; drift is reported, and only the real fixture OCR decides pass/fail.

ocr.install_policy: Branch B only: install into the pipeline's dedicated venv (never global Python) and point PRESENTATION_PIPELINE_INTERPRETER at that venv's interpreter; provision the native tesseract binary with an explicit path on PATH.
ocr.receipt_binding: A Step 0 receipt names the interpreter it measured. A different interpreter selected later FAILS launch; it never borrows the receipt.
